source_logic_conclusions.selection: abs fc1 target-by-regulator column > cutoff; stable descending sort; ceil(n*0.5) for strongest half
source_logic_conclusions.criterion: posterior_seed cell-effect Spearman >=0.8; mean fate-delta signs agree only when both magnitudes >1e-4

limitations: No nontrivial mean-fate rows makes the sign gate vacuously true and agreement null; this is no directional evidence.

criterion is posterior-sampling stability for one trained model; not training-seed or biological validation.
both_mean_effects_above_1e4 column uses actual threshold 1e-4 despite its ambiguous name.
